units.source_text: 我确信我绝对不会博得女子的爱。

en.t: I was convinced that I would never win a woman's love.

units.source_text: 也许你知道了，这种确信比人们所想像的更安乐、更平和。

en.t: Perhaps you already know this, but such certainty is more comfortable and more peaceful than people imagine.

units.source_text: 不同自己的存在条件和解的决心和这种确信不一定没有矛盾。

en.t: The resolve not to reconcile myself with the conditions of my own existence and this certainty were not necessarily free of contradiction.

units.source_text: 因为假如我相信以我这样的状态而能够博得女人的爱，那光凭这一点就足以说明我已同自己的存在条件和解了。

en.t: Because if I believed that, in the state I was in, I could win a woman's love, that alone would be enough to show that I had already reconciled myself with the conditions of my own existence.

units.source_text: 我知道正确判断的勇气与同这种判断做斗争的勇气是很容易互相适应的。

en.t: I knew that the courage to make a correct judgment and the courage to struggle against that judgment could very easily accommodate each other.

units.source_text: 尽管我存在，但总觉得是在斗争。

en.t: Even though I existed, I always felt as though I were in a struggle.
